Aisha R: Heads up — hit a weird bug integrating rerank into our onboarding sample app. When a retry fires the batch helper sometimes reorders the payload, server returns embeddings but SDK maps them back by index so results end up attached to wrong queries. :confounded:
Tom B: wow. can you paste the outgoing payload + returned body?
Aisha R: outgoing (batched):
````
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "queries": [
    {"id":"q-alpha","vector":[0.01,0.02,...]},
    {"id":"q-bravo","vector":[0.03,0.04,...]},
    {"id":"q-charlie","vector":[]}
  ]
}
````
returned: 200 with body: `{"results":[{"score":0.9},{"score":0.6},{"score":0.75}],"meta":{"field":"embeddings"}}`
Aisha R: but because retry dropped q-charlie then resent, the helper reordered to [alpha,charlie,bravo] on the second attempt; SDK naively zipped responses to original order and assigned scores wrong.
Priya S: two problems: (1) batching helper mutates order when filtering/retrying; (2) SDK assumes stable order + consistent field names.
Tom B: Also noticed some older model variants reply with `features` or `embedding` single vector instead of `embeddings` array. Node sdk expected array and exploded.
Priya S: And another annoying bit: the sample app sanitizer in Node coerces numeric tokens to strings when reading from storage so vectors become ["0.01","0.02"], server accepts them but downstream JS math fails.
Devex Bot: Suggestion: implement a normalization step at SDK boundary: normalizeBatch(batch) -> { items: [{id, vector}], idMap: {tempId: originalIndex} } and then map results by id instead of by index.
Tom B: Agree. Proposed quick fixes: 1) batching helper must attach stable request_id per item and never change order in-flight; 2) SDK should map responses by request_id; 3) strict validator on enqueue: if !Array.isArray(vec) or vec.length !== EXPECTED_DIM -> reject with clear error; 4) tolerant parser: accept embeddings|embedding|features and coerce string-number -> float.
Aisha R: For immediate unblock I added a defensive map-by-id in sample-app and a warn log when string numbers seen. Patch: https://git.internal/repo/sample-app/commit/5f2c9
Priya S: We should also update retry policy: do not retry on 4xx JSON validation errors, and make retries idempotent (server-safe).
Tom B: I'll add tests: simulate partial empty vector + reorder during retry and assert mapping by id. Also add unit that feeds stringified floats into parser.
Devex Bot: Action items assigned: Tom -> node batching helper + tests; Priya -> SDK normalization + docs; Aisha -> sample-app quickfix and e2e; Ops -> ops-bot update backoff config for CI.
ops-bot: CI retry backoff updated: jittered exponential backoff applied, 4xx retries suppressed (rule #devex-embed-01).
Aisha R: Thanks all, this one was subtle. Will follow up with a short note in quickstart about canonical vector shape + sanitizer snippet.
Tom B: I'll include compatibility shim: `normalizeEmbeddings(resp) => ({embeddings: resp.embeddings || resp.embedding || resp.features || []})` and coerce types via `map(Number)` to ensure floats.
Priya S: Nice. Once PRs land I'll cut a changelog entry under devex: "fix: stable id mapping for rerank batches, normalize embedding fields, strict vector validation"
Devex Bot: Marking thread resolved pending PR merges.
